recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is recommended for FHIR-7564; any future lifecycle-specific work should be evaluated in the FHIR Extension Pack where auditevent-Lifecycle now lives.
issue_request: FHIR-7564 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for the Security WG's 2015May AuditEvent value-set concern. It requested relaxing AuditEvent.source.type, AuditEvent.object.type, AuditEvent.object.role, and AuditEvent.object.lifecycle to coded data with Preferred bindings, allowing additional value sets, adding guidance that profiles/IGs should specify event-specific AuditEvent recording rules, and updating Scope and Usage with ASTM and ISO foundations.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied in commit 8e1a48066d70501f76de61f4511ec19b48da2df2, which named 7564 in the subject, added the AuditEvent standards list, and changed the then-current object type/role/lifecycle rows from code to Coding. Later source conversions carried the family forward as AuditEvent.source.type, AuditEvent.entity.type, AuditEvent.entity.role, and AuditEvent.entity.lifecycle.
additional_context: AuditEvent remains in the active build. Later published decisions intentionally changed the literal 2015 shape: FHIR-32460 changed relevant AuditEvent Coding elements to CodeableConcept, FHIR-32463 made source.type Preferred with DICOM translation guidance, FHIR-32467/FHIR-32466 removed entity.type as redundant with entity.what, FHIR-32468 changed entity.role to an example binding, and FHIR-32470 removed entity.lifecycle from core and moved the capability to the auditevent-Lifecycle extension in the FHIR Extension Pack.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing removed elements, narrowing CodeableConcept back to Coding, or strengthening entity.role/lifecycle bindings would conflict with later published work-group decisions. Current narrative still says DICOM/IHE/ISO codes are guidance that should be used when suitable, other codes can be defined, and implementation guides may clarify AuditEvent requirements.
